item.title: Intensified U.S.-Canada Trade Negotiations Risk Consequences
item.description: Lower U.S. inflation depends partly on reduced economic disruption from trade disputes and conflicts, but recent developments have increased tensions.

item.title: Innovative cooling methods aim to reduce air conditioning power use
item.description: As Americans rely heavily on air conditioning to cope with rising temperatures, engineers are developing new ways to cool people without increasing electricity demand.

item.title: AI and alcohol policies among surprising factors in U.S. crime drop
item.description: The U.S. is seeing one of the largest crime declines in recent history. Researchers are uncertain of the exact causes but point to several unexpected influences.

item.title: Bessent announces new sanctions aimed at weakening Iran
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Monday that the U.S. will impose strict sanctions on countries and entities that trade with Iran, targeting its economy.
